description: Configuration for automatic bug assignment based on category. Maps bug categories to GitHub usernames.

ui.description: User interface bugs, visual issues, styling problems

functionality.description: Functional bugs, business logic issues, API problems

performance.description: Performance issues, slow load times, optimization needs

security.description: Security vulnerabilities, authentication issues, data privacy concerns

aiSuggestionPrompt.prompt: Based on the bug description and technical context, suggest which team or individual would be best suited to handle this issue. Consider the technical domain, affected components, and required expertise.
